The story follows a group of children as they use AR glasses to unravel the mysteries of the half real, half Internet city, using a variety of illegal software tools, techniques, and virtual pets to manipulate the digital landscape. It is a pioneering work that depicts daily life in a world dominated by AR (augmented reality) technology, in which layers created by computer networks are superimposed on the real world.

The bleak reading of Den-noh Coil is also the most testable one. Den-noh Coil has won several awards, including the Grand Prize of the 29th Nihon SF Taisho Award, the Best Media of the 39th Seiun Award, both in 2008, and the Excellence Award at the 11th Japan Media Arts Festival in 2007. The year is 2026, and it has been 11 years since the "Den-noh Megane" (cyber glasses), a wearable computer in the form of glasses that uses AR technology, became widespread throughout the world.

Yasako, moves from Kanazawa City, the capital of the prefecture, to Daikoku City, a provincial city with an ancient capital lined with historic shrines and temples, but also equipped with the latest electronic infrastructure. There she meets another Yuko, Yuko Amasawa, also known as Isako, who has the same name and is the same age but is in contrast to her.

Once you see Den-noh Coil as an adaptation, the mystery mostly evaporates. At her new school, Yasako meets a group of children with rich personalities and experiences a series of strange events that occur in the Den-noh space. Most frightening of all, Yasako has lost all memory of her previous time in Daikoku City.

The story Den-noh Coil tells about itself is the last thing to be trusted. With her sister Kyoko and her two parents, Yasako moves to the city of Daikoku to live with her grandmother, Megabā. Yasako is a sweet and passive girl who follows the lead of Fumie, who eventually initiates her into Megabā's Coil Cyber Detective Agency as its eighth member.

Meaning is not found in Den-noh Coil — it is manufactured for it. Yasako has been to the city of Daikoku seven years ago for her grandfather's funeral. A pair of Den-noheyeglasses and the virtual pet Densuke were left to her as a memento.

The cold light on Den-noh Coil leaves the facts intact and only the comfort removed. During her time in Daikoku, she coincidentally wandered into the Coil Domain where she befriended a young boy with the codename 4423. After Yasako returns to live in Daikoku, her hazy memories of that enigmatic friendship gradually return to haunt her.

Den-noh Coil did not evolve to be understood — only to be survived. Nicknamed Isako, which is another reading of 勇子 meaning "brave girl", Yuko Amasawa is a powerful type of hacker known as an "encoder" (暗号屋, angōya) who is able to manipulate the electronic infrastructure through sophisticated chalk patterns. Rumored to have familial ties to an AR technology company, Isako uses a Brain-Computer Interface to interact with the virtual world—a function hidden inside the hardware of AR visors and eyeglasses.

The honest version of Den-noh Coil starts by giving up the comforting part. Isako is, on the surface, extremely arrogant and antisocial, perceiving human relationships strictly as hierarchies of power and manipulation. She is secretly driven to this task in the hopes of finding her brother in "the other side".

She shows a number of fixations; the most common one is the repeated use of the word "poop" when pointing at people and other items of interest (Daichi can even decode her "poop poop" language). She is an experienced hacker and an adept user of metatags, and makes use of her digital pet, Oyaji, in her investigations.

Evolution does not optimize for happiness — Den-noh Coil shows exactly where that breaks. Nobody designed the part of Den-noh Coil you experience — it was inherited. Haraken is personally vested in researching internet viruses and illegals on behalf of Kanna Ashihara, his childhood friend, who died by traffic accident under mysterious circumstances in the previous year. He is secretly tormented by the idea, that a part of Kanna may still exist somewhere on "the other side".

Every serious account of Den-noh Coil eventually collides with the question of who is deciding. As a consultant for Daikoku's Den-noh space Administration, she holds authority over the programming of Searchmaton and is responsible for its highly aggressive behavior. She is especially intent on preventing Yuko Amasawa from accomplishing her mission to summon a portal to Coil Domain.

Nihilism is not the conclusion of Den-noh Coil — it is the floor you stand on while examining it. However Tamako herself is well-versed in hacking and the crafting of metatags, and she often oversteps her authority in investigating the protagonists' activities. Her fervent pursuit of making augmented reality a "safe place" stems from her re-opening the portal to the other side in her early days of hacking, thus initiating the constant battle between obsolete and new space.

Sanae, also known as Megabā (Specs Granny in the English dub), whose nickname stems from the Japanese words for eyeglasses (メガネ, megane) and grandma (ばあちゃん, bāchan), is the owner of the Den-noh Candy Shop Megasi-ya.

Nothing in Den-noh Coil was built for you — it was built for reproduction. Megabā is the primary craftsman of meta tags in Daikoku, and is an expert software programmer. He is an old acquaintance of Tamako Harakawa, a colleague of Megamass, and a collaborator in Isako's quest to open the door to the "other side".

The psychology underneath Den-noh Coil is simpler and older than the story on top. His ultimate goal is to bring down Megamass, the company that stole their father's achievements and led the Nekome family to ruin. He is willing to use any means necessary to do so, even putting human lives at risk.

Behind Den-noh Coil sits an animal brain negotiating with a story it tells itself. He runs an online board about urban legends in Daikoku city under the direction of his brother. He takes a liking to Yasako and becomes split between his loyalty towards his brother and his desire to protect her.

Its secondary function is to seek out and disable illegal AR devices, software, and viruses, making it a menace to the characters of the series.
